subject.title: fix(sessions): keep Matrix DM session keys case-distinct per peer

question: Should OpenClaw land this bounded fix for `per-channel-peer` and `per-account-channel-peer` while explicitly retaining the case-collision behavior of channel-agnostic `per-peer`?
rationale: The patch is deliberately partial to preserve the established `per-peer` persisted-key contract; choosing whether that residual cross-principal transcript risk is acceptable requires owner judgment beyond a mechanical correctness review.

options.title: Land the bounded mitigation
options.body: Accept the documented `per-peer` limitation, keep the canonical issue open, and land after rebase plus focused session regression proof.

options.title: Require a complete scope solution
options.body: Pause this PR until the canonical issue has an approved design for distinguishing case-sensitive identities in channel-agnostic `per-peer` keys.

recommendation.title: Land the bounded mitigation
recommendation.body: Accept the documented `per-peer` limitation, keep the canonical issue open, and land after rebase plus focused session regression proof.
